scope: Compare native utf8mb4 VARCHAR fields under their resolved utf8mb4_bin collation, and compose in projection, filters, ordinary joins and checked single-target writes.

Predicate/Text/TextComparison.role: A native integer truth comparison over checked nonbinary text operands.
Predicate/Text/TextComparison.structure: A comparison operator, two ordered text field, plain text literal or NULL operands, and the effective builtin collation.
Predicate/Text/TextComparison.conditions: At least one operand is a checked VARCHAR field. Each text field owns its native utf8mb4_bin reference and lower coercibility than plain text or NULL. Signed operands and other collations require their own comparison roles.
Predicate/Text/TextComparison.meaning: Use PAD SPACE comparison over Unicode code points. The six ordinary comparisons yield NULL for a NULL operand. NULL-safe equality distinguishes both NULL, one NULL and neither NULL.
Predicate/Text/TextComparison.sql: Group both exact typed operands under the native operator. The stock field collation supplies the selection through native coercibility.

Predicate/Text/TextOperator.role: An exact native text comparison operation.
Predicate/Text/TextOperator.structure: Seven closed operator values, including NULL-safe equality.
Predicate/Text/TextOperator.conditions: The two operands meet the owning text comparison contract. The spellings != and <> select the same inequality.
Predicate/Text/TextOperator.meaning: Evaluate the ordered relation or NULL-safe equality using the named collation.
Predicate/Text/TextOperator.sql: Emit the exact fixed operator spelling.
